claim: Luxshare received approval in Nov 2023 for an additional US$330 million investment in its Bac Giang, Vietnam plant (raising total investment to US$504 million); the 70-acre facility -- producing cables, touch pens, smart positioning tags and smartwatch components -- is officially expected to be completed in 12 to 24 months.
stance_target: load-bearing capex-to-output lead-time figure: Vietnam facility construction runs 1-2 years, independently confirming the faster end of the AppleInsider 2020 5-month figure is not an outlier but part of a consistent single-digit-months-to-2-years construction-lead-time range
scope_conditions: one Luxshare facility, Bac Giang province, construction-to-completion only (not full volume ramp), announced Nov 2023
quoted_support: The new facility, under Luxshare's arm in Vietnam, will be on a plot of over 70 acres and is expected to be completed in 12 to 24 months... The additional amount raises the total plant investment to US$504 million.
